responsibility: Implements language-independent named-return-value style optimizations for aggregate returns and caller return-slot reuse. One pass detects functions that always return the same local aggregate, rewrites all references from that local to the function RESULT_DECL, removes the final copy, and preserves useful debug identity; the companion pass marks aggregate-returning calls whose destination can safely serve as the callee’s return slot, enabling later copy-elision by expansion.
